asr.full_text: I work in technology at JPMorgan Chase. There are 50,000 agents in JPMorgan Chase supporting millions of external customers. When the external customer wants to make contact with JPMorgan Chase they do it via the call center agents and the technology used to facilitate those conversations is what our team manages. JPMorgan Chase spends about eight billion dollars a year in technology. Any technology imaginable is being done at JPMorgan Chase today whether it's cloud computing, big data analytics, social, mobile interactions, object-oriented programming, Java programming, Ruby on Rails, just about anything you can do a technology we do at Chase. With no technology, there is no financial services. How money is moved, how customers get their account balances, how transactions are done, is all being done via the technology we support at Jacob Morton Chase. I'm currently in asset management over-setting control analyst. Over-setting control is essentially the first line of defense I'm currently an Asset Management Oversight and Control Analyst. Oversight and Control is essentially the first line of defense, trying to identify any risks or controls that asset management currently has.
